descriptions.w3d_d24b_object_menu_key_80099aa8: Debug object-menu key handler: dispatches on the state +40. List state: N/P page through the entries (19 per page, refresh 0x800990a4, options 0x80099998), ?/ show help (0x80099a20), T toggles +56, S cycles the filter +60 up to +28 then -1, Y cycles +76 through 0..7, R rebuilds (0x800994b4), other keys select an entry through the key tables 0x804aabc8/0x804aabcc when its slot +80 reports lines (0x80099dc0).
